checks.detail: all three consumers import the shared contract
checks.title: API, public boundary and browser import the same contract module

checks.detail: proxy forwards response.body for the stream path
checks.title: The private proxy relays the stream instead of re-implementing it

checks.detail: both contours emit through the shared writer
checks.title: Both server contours emit through one GatewayStreamWriter

checks.detail: frames are validated on both ends
checks.title: Every frame is validated at runtime on the server and in the browser

checks.detail: declared events: meta, token, citation, assessment, done, error
checks.title: The contract declares exactly meta, token, citation, assessment, done, error

checks.detail: refused verbs: command, confirmAction, confirm_action, execute, executeAction, execute_action, mutation, preparedAction, prepared_action, write
checks.title: Every write verb is refused by the contract

checks.detail: the forbidden-key scan recurses into nested objects
checks.title: Write verbs are refused at any nesting depth, not only at the top level

checks.detail: prepared_action appears only in the contract's refusal list
checks.title: prepared_action exists only as a refused key, never as a type, emission or UI value

checks.detail: assessment is pinned to NOT_ATTESTED
checks.title: An assessment cannot raise operational maturity

checks.detail: usable requires done, complete, no refusal and non-empty text
checks.title: resolveOutcome returns text only for a stream that completed

checks.detail: a refused snapshot carries no text
checks.title: The browser drops partial text unless done{complete:true} arrived

checks.detail: a rejected frame ends the stream with a refusal and done{complete:false}
checks.title: A frame the contract rejects seals the stream instead of being skipped

checks.detail: both panels drop the provisional message
checks.title: Both panels remove the provisional message rather than dimming it

checks.detail: refused identity keys: dealId, roleId, subjectId, tenantId
checks.title: Identity, tenant and Deal keys are refused inside any frame

checks.detail: the identity scan runs regardless of mode
checks.title: Identity is refused in the private mode too, not only the public one

checks.detail: the public writer is constructed in public mode
checks.title: The public boundary validates every frame in public mode

checks.detail: the public boundary reaches no account data
checks.title: The public boundary imports no session, Deal or account source

checks.detail: the actor is resolved by the guard and passed to the service
checks.title: The private stream takes its actor from the server guard, never from the body

checks.detail: the stream path forwards response.body
checks.title: The proxy forwards the stream body instead of reading it to a string

checks.detail: the stream path forwards request.signal upstream
checks.title: The reader's cancellation reaches upstream instead of a fixed deadline

checks.detail: a demo session cannot receive a demo gateway stream
checks.title: The gateway stream is never answered from the demo bank

checks.detail: the private panel validates frames as private
checks.title: The private panel reads the stream in private mode

checks.detail: both refusals are representable and returned by resolveAdmission
checks.title: Without admission the stream refuses with FEATURE_DISABLED or MODEL_NOT_ADMITTED

checks.detail: the admission refusal returns before chat() is reached
checks.title: The generation service is not called at all without admission

checks.detail: an unset or malformed flag reads as disabled
checks.title: Production feature flags are off unless explicitly set to true

checks.detail: no substitute answer is constructed on any streaming path
checks.title: No streaming path constructs a mock, stub or canned answer
